blocks.tamil_translation: Whoever does good deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer (in the One God), We will surely make him live a pure life (in this world); and (in the Hereafter) We will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اللهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزاً عَظِيماً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great success.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ؕ وَاللهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Say, (O Prophet): “If you love Allah, then follow me; (then) Allah will love you and forgive you your sins - and Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّلِحتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمنُ وُدّاً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, those who believe (in the One God) and do good deeds - the Most Merciful will create for them love (from all things).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّلِحتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخفُ ظُلْماً وَلَا هَضْماً۞).
